data.one_liner: Adapter that connects the graphql package to an Nhost.io GraphQL backend
data.what_it_does: It provides a thin wrapper around the graphql client, preconfiguring links and headers for Nhost services. The package handles authentication tokens and endpoint URLs automatically, so you can start issuing queries and mutations right away.
use_when: You need to talk to an Nhost GraphQL backend in a Dart or Flutter app
You already use the graphql package and want minimal boilerplate for Nhost
avoid_when: You are using a different GraphQL client such as graphql_flutter or a custom HTTP client
You need advanced GraphQL features not exposed by the adapter
strengths: Zero configuration beyond adding the dependency
Automatic handling of auth tokens and endpoint URLs
weaknesses: No code generation or schema introspection support
Limited to the graphql package API
data.setup_notes: Add `nhost_graphql_adapter: ^4.0.10` to pubspec.yaml and import the package. No build_runner or permissions required.
